title: Northgate Tire Center Tariff Schedule — Rotation Rates by Package Age
content:
# Rotation rates by package age

**Schedule.** A Northgate Tire Center rotation charge carries a package-age rate read from the whole calendar months from the package's installation date to the service date of the rotation entry (the most recent rotation entry recorded on the package). A month counts once its day of the month is reached.

| Whole months from installation to the rotation entry | Package-age rate |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | 0.5 |
| at least 12 and fewer than 24 | 0.75 |
| 24 or more | 1 — the full rate |

**How the rate acts.** The rotation charge is multiplied by the package-age rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical: installation on 2024-08-20)

| Rotation entry dated | Whole months | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-08-19 | 11 | 0.5 |
| 2025-08-20 | 12 | 0.75 |
| 2026-08-19 | 23 | 0.75 |
| 2026-08-20 | 24 | 1 |

A rotation charge of $24.00 before this rate becomes $12.00 at 0.5 and $18.00 at 0.75.
